findings.evidence: Mathlib/RingTheory/Ideal/Maps.lean:1061 defines `Ideal.map_eq_bot_iff_of_injective`; the new proof itself is exactly two conversions by `mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero` around that theorem.
findings.fix: Remove the declaration and use `mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero` followed by `Ideal.map_eq_bot_iff_of_injective f.injective` at its call sites.

findings.evidence: Mathlib/RingTheory/Ideal/Norm/RelNorm.lean:322 defines `Ideal.relNorm_map_algEquiv`; line 136 proves the wrapper by that theorem alone.
findings.fix: Delete the wrapper and rewrite line 170 directly with `Ideal.relNorm_map_algEquiv (ringOfIntegersQuadraticConjₐ hmin hgen) J`.

summary: The PR adds a public direct restatement of existing Mathlib API and an unnecessary private wrapper around another existing theorem.
